public.header: Clean navbar with logo and back button or action button

instructions_to_main_agent: Language: Entire interface must be in Spanish (Activos, Solicitudes, Usuarios, Reportar problema, etc.).
Primary Color: Deep blue (#002699) used for primary buttons, active state highlights, key metrics, and brand header elements.
Data Test IDs: ALL interactive elements and text fields MUST have explicit data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='login-email-input', data-testid='create-asset-button').
File Extensions: Remember all React source components are .js files (not .tsx).
QR Code Functionality: QR codes generated for assets must lead to the public responsive page `/p/asset/:qr_code` (or public asset view) with the 'REPORTAR PROBLEMA' button clearly prominent.
QR Printable Card: The QR detail view must feature a clean, styled modal/card designed for print (@media print) with Asset Code, Asset Name, Location, and printable QR code image.

Public Tracking Page: Public request tracking page must be accessible via public URL `/p/request/:token` showing correlative number (SOL-000001), status badge, asset info, timeline/history of status changes with date, time, and comments.
Status Timeline: Request detail page and public tracking page must present a vertical visual timeline component for status changes.
Sidebar Navigation: Authenticated views must have a responsive dark sidebar with brand logo, nav items with active indicator, user info footer, and logout button.
Toasts & Notifications: Use Sonner for toast notifications on asset creation, editing, request submission, and status updates.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered slop layout. Use visual hierarchy, generous padding, sharp icons, clear borders, and high contrast typography.
Gradients on dark colors are forbidden. Keep solid dark slate/navy sidebar with crisp border-r border-slate-800.
Ensure every form field has explicit placeholder, helper text, and accessible validation feedback.
Ensure responsive design works flawlessly on mobile screens (<640px) with hamburger menu for sidebar and touch-friendly targets (min 44px height).
